intent: Analyze system crashes during gaming sessions
detected_fault: Driver issues (Nvidia or Windows) and/or hardware failure (GPU, RAM, etc.)
suggested_solution: Update Nvidia drivers to the latest version.
Run a stress test on the GPU (e.g., Unigine Heaven) to identify potential hardware issues.
Check for BIOS updates and install the latest version.
Adjust power saving plans to High Performance mode, both on battery and plugged-in states, to rule out power-related issues.
